effect_description_eng: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Jellymon] in its text and 1 card with the [DS] trait among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.). Then, if your hand has 7 or more cards, trash 1 card in your hand.
